name: Kinder Morgan Louisiana Pipeline

values.StartLocation: Sabine Pass LNG Terminal, Cameron Parish
values.EndLocation: Columbia Gulf Transmission interconnect, Evangeline Parish
values.Owner: Kinder Morgan Louisiana Pipeline Co LLC

researcher_notes: Not in the tracker under any name. P2559 Magnolia Gas Pipeline is a different project: the planned reversal of this line to feed the Magnolia LNG export terminal (EIA row 'Lake Charles Expansion (Magnolia LNG)', 202 miles of 0 new pipe, 1,362 MMcf/d). The Texas Access Project (CP26-136, 3.05 mi) is a separate expansion of this line, below the length rule. Existing line. EIA historical sheet row 600 of the August 2026 release: Kinder Morgan Louisiana Pipeline, new pipeline, completed June 2009, 132 miles, 2,130 MMcf/d, 24 and 42 inch, Louisiana, FERC docket CP06-449. A Natural Gas Intelligence report on the FERC approval (January 2007) gives 132 miles of 42-inch pipe from the Sabine Pass LNG terminal in Cameron Parish to a Columbia Gulf interconnect in Evangeline Parish, plus a 2.3-mile 24-inch lateral, peak capacity 2,130 thousand Dth per day, and a second leg of 1 mile of 36-inch pipe; it also names the owner as a Kinder Morgan Energy Partners subsidiary. The FERC final environmental impact statement page for the project was loaded and confirms the project exists (docket CP06-449). EIA and Natural Gas Intelligence figures agree; the two sources are different publishers. Cost left blank: Natural Gas Intelligence said 517 million USD at approval and EIA lists 1,000 million, a conflict. Start year 2009 comes from the EIA completed date (2009-06-21); the 2007 article had expected mid-2008. Owner spelled as the tracker already spells it (exact entity match). Route not researched; no official GIS located, so route fields mirror P2559's 'no route'. Adds 132 mi (about 212 km) of new pipe, passes the 25 km rule. Interstate, so FERC-regulated. Confidence high.
